extractions.description: The paper proposes ConceptGraphs, an open-vocabulary object-centric 3D scene graph representation built from posed RGB-D sequences using off-the-shelf 2D foundation models (SAM, CLIP, Grounding DINO, RAM), an LVLM (LLaVA) for node captioning and an LLM (GPT-4) for edge relations and task planning. It is evaluated on Replica scene graph accuracy, open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation, text-based object retrieval, and real-world robot demonstrations (Jackal UGV navigation/object search/traversability, Spot Arm pick-and-place, AI2Thor localization/map update).

type.quote: In experiments, we demonstrate that ConceptGraphs is able to discover, map, and caption a large number of objects in a scene.
type.justification: The paper builds a system and evaluates it on datasets and real robots.
